Hi Laura / Marissa,

Quick summary: Nimbus has accepted the majority of our commercial redlines after yesterday's call. They've attached a redlined clean of both the MSA and the Order Form. Before we prepare the DocuSign envelope I need confirmation on two items from Legal:

1) Signer authority for Nimbus — their point of contact said CFO (Teresa Alvarez) and CEO (Ravi Patel) are the preferred signers but Teresa may delegate. We need either a POA or an explicit delegation e-mail on company letterhead.

2) Redwood signing sequence and final document custody — should we route the envelope so Redwood signs first (VP Legal -> CRO) or sign after the customer? Also confirm we should lock the final clean PDFs in the contracts Drive folder and send a Distributor copy to Finance.

Attachments: MSA_Nimbus_redline_v3.docx, OrderForm_Nimbus_redline_v2.docx

Ask: Laura, can you confirm the signing order and whether you want me to create the envelope with the routing/template you usually use (I attached the Routing_template_redwood.docusign)? If you prefer Legal to create the envelope, say the word and I will hand off.

I'll also include the HubSpot deal link in the envelope (HubSpot ID included below) and set the envelope to require signer ID verification for the CFO.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876543210-RDW-2026-045

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Karthik —

Thanks for the note and for sending the redlines. I reviewed both documents quickly; commercial looks good but there are two legal housekeeping items to lock before we send:

- Data retention clause: we accepted Nimbus's proposal but need an audit log entry added to the Order Form appendix. I'll insert a one-line amendment and attach a final PDF.
- Indemnity cross-reference: I will add a parenthetical to the MSA section 9.3 to match our template.

Routing / signing sequence: please have Redwood sign first. Reasoning: preserves our right to execute immediately on our side and prevents a partial-executed state if the customer stops mid-route. Sequence I want in the envelope:
  1) Redwood: Laura Bennett (VP Legal) — sign
  2) Redwood: Jayden Cruz (CRO) — sign
  3) Nimbus: Teresa Alvarez (CFO) — sign (or delegated signee if POA provided)
  4) Nimbus: Ravi Patel (CEO) — sign

I will prepare a short attestation statement to add as a signer instruction that the CFO's signature must be accompanied by either: (a) a scanned POA (signed + notarized if available) or (b) an e-mail from contracts@nimbushealth.com on corporate letterhead naming the delegated signee. Please route any POA documents to legal@redwood.ai for recordkeeping.

I can create the envelope using the Routing_template_redwood.docusign you attached. If you create it, include 'lock documents after signature' and 'certificate of completion' options. If I create it, I'll add the audit log and indemnity tweak first and then drop in the clean PDFs. Either way: once signed, final clean copies should be uploaded to the Drive folder and the HubSpot deal updated.

Please go ahead and build the envelope (so we control the timing). I'll stand by to review before send.

-Laura
--
Laura Bennett
VP, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
